in_hebrew.name: Silvina
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Shining, from the forest
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Silvina הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word silva, meaning 'forest' or 'woods'. The name Silvina signifies one who comes from the forest or is shining and radiant like the forest.

in_greek.name: Silvina
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Shining, from the forest
in_greek.long_meaning: Silvina είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Latin word silva, meaning 'forest' or 'woods'. The name Silvina signifies one who comes from the forest or is shining and radiant like the forest.

in_latin.name: Silvina
in_latin.meaning: a forest or wood; a woman from the forest
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen gentilicium ex silva, quae significat forestam vel silvam, in quo significat feminam de silva, nomen eximium in ecclesia Christiana, significans feminam qui est virgo silvatica, et habens virtutes inimicorum silvae, qui est fortis et robusta, ut silva, et qui est amabilis et pulchra, ut silva est pulchra.
